rule_types.free_plan: Whether a permanent free tier exists, and what caps it
rule_types.volume_band: Price rises with a meter (orders/contacts/tickets) at fixed bands
rule_types.overage: Per-unit charge once the included amount is used
rule_types.metered_addon: Separate meter billed on top of the plan
rule_types.minimum_spend: A floor you pay even on the cheapest plan
rule_types.annual_discount: Discount for paying yearly instead of monthly
rule_types.seat_billing: Price multiplies with people, not usage
rule_types.tax_treatment: Whether tax is included in the published price
rule_types.trial: Whether the free entry is a trial rather than a permanent tier

rules.detail: Permanent free tier capped at 250 active profiles and 500 email sends per month
Above 500 profiles the price is set by contact count in Klaviyo's calculator
Free tier includes $5 of SMS/MMS credit a month, not unlimited messaging
$0.40 per ticket over the included volume on Starter and Basic, $0.36 on Pro
AI Agent interactions $0.90 each annually, $1.00 monthly, and each also consumes ticket volume
Starter includes 3 agents; larger plans add agent capacity with the plan tier
Four order bands; the feature set is identical at every band
Permanent free tier with unlimited review requests
No volume or seat scaling: the Awesome plan is a flat $15 with no higher tier
Scale $299/mo becomes $249/mo billed annually; Elite $899 becomes $749
The free tier is a 14-day trial of the paid product, not a permanent plan
Prices shown in EUR and USD exclude VAT
$49 monthly minimum spend applies even on the $0/mo Starter tier
Messages billed per unit on top, and a dedicated short code costs $750/month through the carriers
Free reviews plan stops at 50 monthly orders
Reviews, loyalty and discovery are priced as separate product lines, each with its own tiers
$25/$45/$75 per user per month depending on plan
Extra inboxes $10/mo each, extra docs sites $20/mo each, on top of seats
No permanent free plan; the free trial ends and the $9 tier is the floor
Five order bands from 200 to 100,000 orders, with AI moderation and replies included at every band
Yearly billing takes 30% off
